title: Common risk factors in the returns on stocks and bonds
authors: Eugene F. Fama · Kenneth R. French

summary.en: Examines how market, size, value, term, and default factors relate to stock and bond returns.
summary.zh: 研究市场、规模、价值、期限与违约等因素如何与股票及债券收益相关。

title: Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers: Implications for Stock Market Efficiency

summary.en: Studies return persistence through portfolios formed from prior winners and losers.
summary.zh: 通过历史赢家与输家组合，研究收益的延续性及其市场效率含义。

summary.en: Models how private information, order flow, and market-maker pricing interact in continuous auctions.
summary.zh: 建模分析连续竞价中私人信息、订单流与做市定价之间的关系。

summary.en: Frames execution as a balance between market impact, timing risk, and trading horizon.
summary.zh: 从市场冲击、时间风险与交易周期之间的权衡来刻画执行问题。

title: Price Momentum and Trading Volume
authors: Charles M. C. Lee · Bhaskaran Swaminathan

summary.en: Examines how trading volume can help interpret the persistence and reversal of price momentum.
summary.zh: 研究交易量如何帮助理解价格动量的延续与反转。

title: The Cross-Section of Expected Stock Returns
authors: Eugene F. Fama · Kenneth R. French

summary.en: Studies how firm size, book-to-market, leverage, and earnings-to-price relate to expected returns.
summary.zh: 研究公司规模、账面市值比、杠杆及盈价比与预期收益的关系。

title: The Development of China's Stock Market and Stakes for the Global Economy
authors: Jennifer N. Carpenter · Robert F. Whitelaw

summary.en: Reviews the ownership, institutional structure, and market development of China's stock market.
summary.zh: 梳理中国股票市场的所有权、制度结构与市场发展特征。

title: Media Coverage and the Cross-section of Stock Returns

summary.en: Examines how differences in media coverage relate to the cross-section of stock returns.
summary.zh: 研究媒体覆盖差异如何与股票横截面收益表现相关。

title: CSI 300 Index Methodology
data: constituents · free-float market cap · corporate actions

summary.en: Explains the index universe, selection, weighting, review, and adjustment methodology.
summary.zh: 说明指数样本空间、选样、加权、定期审核与调整方法。

summary.en: Provides a structured reference for market scale, listings, trading activity, and financing statistics.
summary.zh: 提供市场规模、上市公司、交易活动与融资统计的结构化年度参考。

title: Findings Regarding the Market Events of May 6, 2010

summary.en: Reconstructs a market-structure event using synchronized order, trade, quote, and futures evidence.
summary.zh: 使用同步的订单、成交、报价与期货证据重建一次市场结构事件。

title: Staff Report on Equity and Options Market Structure Conditions in Early 2021
data: prices · options · short interest · account activity

summary.en: Organizes market, options, short-interest, and participation evidence around a high-attention trading episode.
summary.zh: 围绕一次高关注交易事件，整理市场、期权、卖空与参与者活动证据。

title: Modeling and Forecasting Realized Volatility
authors: Torben G. Andersen · Tim Bollerslev · Francis X. Diebold · Paul Labys
data: minute returns · sampling interval · session boundaries · missingness

summary.en: Shows how high-frequency returns can be aggregated into realized-volatility measures for lower-frequency analysis.
summary.zh: 说明如何将高频收益聚合为已实现波动率，用于更低频的分析。

limits.en: A measurement reference, not a volatility forecast or trading signal. Sampling, sessions, and microstructure noise must be specified before applying it to a dataset.
limits.zh: 这是度量参考，不是波动率预测或交易信号。应用到具体数据前，必须明确采样、交易时段与微观结构噪声处理。

title: Intraday Information Efficiency on the Chinese Equity Market
authors: Tao Chen · Jun Cai · Richard Y. K. Ho
data: tick trades · quotes · bid-ask spread · volume

summary.en: Uses tick-by-tick Shanghai evidence to examine intraday spreads and price discovery across more and less liquid stocks.
summary.zh: 使用上交所逐笔数据，研究不同流动性股票的日内价差与价格发现。

limits.en: The study depends on trades and quotes. Minute OHLCV alone cannot reproduce its spread or price-discovery tests; treat it as a Level-2 data requirement, not a current capability.
limits.zh: 研究依赖逐笔成交和报价。仅有分钟 OHLCV 无法复现价差或价格发现检验；应标为 Level-2 数据要求，而非当前能力。

title: Giving Content to Investor Sentiment: The Role of Media in the Stock Market
data: news text · publisher time · entity mapping · returns · volume

summary.en: Studies how the tone of financial media relates to market prices and trading volume.
summary.zh: 研究财经媒体语气如何与市场价格和交易量相关。

limits.en: News timestamp, publisher rights, source lineage, and entity mapping are prerequisites. The paper does not turn sentiment text into a recommendation or a licensed dataset.
limits.zh: 新闻时间戳、发布方权利、来源血缘与实体映射是前提。该论文不把情绪文本变成投资建议或已获授权的数据集。

title: Trading and Arbitrage in Cryptocurrency Markets
data: multi-exchange prices · signed volume · fiat markets · exchange identity

summary.en: Documents persistent cross-exchange price deviations and connects them to market segmentation and arbitrage constraints.
summary.zh: 记录持续的跨交易所价格偏离，并将其与市场分割和套利约束联系起来。

limits.en: A single-exchange spot series cannot reproduce a cross-exchange arbitrage study. Use it as market-structure orientation, not evidence of an executable opportunity.
limits.zh: 单一交易所现货序列无法复现跨交易所套利研究。它适合作为市场结构导读，不是可执行机会的证据。

title: Why DeFi Lending? Evidence from Aave V2
authors: Giulio Cornelli · Leonardo Gambacorta · Rodney Garratt · Alessio Reghezza
data: funding rate · open interest · leverage context · protocol transactions

summary.en: Examines motivations for DeFi lending and borrowing, framing leverage and funding conditions as market context rather than a standalone signal.
summary.zh: 研究 DeFi 借贷动机，将杠杆与资金条件视为市场背景，而非独立信号。

limits.en: Its evidence is based on Aave and multi-venue context. A public Binance funding-rate or open-interest series is narrower and must not inherit the paper's conclusions.
limits.zh: 其证据来自 Aave 及多场所背景。公开 Binance 资金费率或持仓量序列范围更窄，不能直接继承论文结论。

title: Form 13F: Official Filing Guidance and EDGAR Data Access
data: institution universe · Form 13F filings · amendments · CIK · submission time

summary.en: Defines the filing context and public access path for institutional Form 13F holdings disclosures.
summary.zh: 界定机构 Form 13F 持仓披露的申报背景与公开访问路径。

limits.en: Form 13F is quarterly and delayed, with amendments and scope limits. It is not a real-time portfolio, broad US-market coverage, or an investment recommendation.
limits.zh: Form 13F 为季度、滞后披露，且存在修订与范围限制；它不是实时组合、全面美股覆盖或投资建议。

title: Binance USDⓈ-M Futures Market Data: Funding Rate and Open Interest
data: frozen symbol universe · funding rate history · open interest · request limits

summary.en: Documents public REST market-data endpoints that define funding-rate and open-interest request shapes for USDⓈ-M futures.
summary.zh: 说明 USDⓈ-M 永续合约的公开 REST 市场数据端点，以及资金费率和持仓量的请求形态。

limits.en: Documentation defines an upstream interface, not TradingDatas coverage. The frozen universe, collection receipts, network access, freshness, and authenticated catalog/query readback remain separate gates.
limits.zh: 文档只定义上游接口，不证明 TradingDatas 覆盖。固定标的范围、采集 receipt、网络可达性、新鲜度及认证 catalog/query 回读仍是独立门槛。
